close_reason:
Extracted build_chat_push_map(cp, context) -> Result<Map, ClientError> private free function in misc.rs. Both push_subscription_create and push_subscription_update Patch::Set arm now call it. Loop-fusion achieved naturally via single-pass insert-then-check (insert returns Some(old) on collision, replacing the two-pass HashSet idiom).

Error message format now identical between the two callers (was 'positional vs implicit format!()' drift before). Behaviour-equivalent on wire shape.

cargo test -p jmap-chat-client green (all 94+ tests). cargo clippy -p jmap-chat-client --all-targets -- -D warnings clean. cargo fmt clean. Committed as 17033be.
description: misc.rs:230-249 (push_subscription_create) and misc.rs:327-344 (push_subscription_update) contain near-identical 20-line blocks: HashSet-based duplicate accountId detection, then a second loop that calls serde_json::to_value(config) for each entry and inserts into chat_push_map. Same logic, two callers, same error-formatting string. Engineering basis: DRY — two copies will drift; the second copy of the duplicate-check accidentally diverged (use of format!() with positional vs implicit). Refactor: extract 'fn build_chat_push_map(cp: &[(&Id, ChatPushConfig)], context: &str) -> Result<serde_json::Map<...>, ClientError>' and call from both sites. The second of the two loops can also be fused into the first (see sibling finding on two-pass iteration).
title: chat_push duplicate-detection + map-build duplicated between create and update
